chapters.chapter_name: Classification of cosmetic and cosmeceutical products
content: Definition of cosmetics as per Indian and EU regulations, Evolution
of cosmeceuticals from cosmetics, cosmetics as quasi and OTC
drugs. Cosmetic excipients: Surfactants, rheology modifiers
humectants, emollients, and preservatives. Classification and
application. Skin: Basic structure and function of the skin. Hair:
Basic structure of the hair. Hair growth cycle. Oral cavity: Common
problem associated with teeth and gums
